args.title: Fix password reset email link to use correct BASE_URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email includes a link constructed with BASE_URL, which defaults to "http://localhost:3000" if PUBLIC_URL is not set. This causes the reset-password link in the email to point to localhost for end users when PUBLIC_URL is missing, which is incorrect.

Propose to ensure that BASE_URL is set correctly from deployment configuration or environment, or to clarify in the config or documentation how to properly set PUBLIC_URL to avoid localhost links in emails. This fixes issue #4201 by preventing password reset emails from linking to localhost.
